description: Use when someone asks how healthy a breed is, which hereditary diseases it has, or which health tests to ask a breeder for (e.g. 'Labrador hip dysplasia tests', 'Französische Bulldogge gesund?'). HonestDog's proprietary per-breed health data: the S–E breeding-health grade with rationale, hereditary diseases, and the health tests breeders should run — L1 = mandated by the breed club's Zuchtordnung. Where HonestDog has an explainer, `qualzucht_traits` lists the breed's extreme-breeding (Qualzucht) traits with their level — a listed trait does not mean every dog of the breed is affected. / HonestDogs Gesundheitsprofil je Rasse: S–E-Note, Erbkrankheiten und die (vom Zuchtverband vorgeschriebenen) Gesundheitstests.

breed_slug.description: Breed slug as returned by search_breeds, e.g. 'zwergpudel'
